wants.description: Other svc ids that should be up first.

user.description: Unix account: root or home (uid 1). Absent means root. Does not create accounts.

env.description: Extra environment for this process. Empty when absent. Wins over host:local.env on the same name.

bind_low_ports.description: When true, a non-root process keeps CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE and may bind ports below 1024. Root does not need this. Default false.
